icons.name: Insight
icons.label: 통찰
icons.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: individual trait icon for a medieval demon-lord fantasy game UI.
Input image 1 is the original icon, a composition and semantic reference only. Redraw it as a smooth NON-PIXEL high resolution icon, not an enlarged pixel sprite. Keep its specific silhouette, major internal gaps, orientation and symbolic meaning.
Subject: a human head profile facing left with a curled brain spiral inside. This is the trait '통찰'.
Style: clean flat vector-like 2D emblem, warm ivory (#E9DFC7), thin charcoal contour, at most very subtle beige two-tone shading. Match a cohesive antique heraldic UI glyph set. Confident flowing antialiased curves and clean angular points. Broad readable shapes at 64 to 100 pixels.
Composition: ONE isolated icon centered in square canvas, occupying about 70–75% of canvas with generous transparent padding.
Background: genuine alpha transparency including internal holes.
Avoid: pixel art, pixel stair steps, blocky raster edges, 3D, metallic rendering, photographic or painted texture, shine, glow, extra ornaments, outer frame, medallion, badge, background, text, letters, numbers, shadow outside the symbol, watermark. Do not add new objects.
